items.title: 星际争霸 开发团队承诺新作定于 2030 年发布

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/SoLVfNbucmbjEmb.jpg
我们采访了这款 星际争霸 新作的开发人员，他们解释了为何公布如此遥远的发布日期，甚至透露了这款备受期待的作品中可能包含的一些游戏元素。
星际争霸 终于要推出新作了，而且它采用了与前作截然不同的方式；暴雪这款冷酷的科幻 IP 并非即时战略游戏，而是首次进军开放世界射击游戏领域，并计划于 2030 年发售。
距离现在还有很长一段时间，四年后的世界会是什么样子谁也说不准。在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上，我们有机会向开发人员提出了大家最关心的问题：如果距离发布还有这么多时间，为什么要现在公布这款游戏？
星际争霸 总经理兼副总裁 Dan Hay 和副总监 AnaLee Haertling 告诉我们，分享一个明确的发布日期有助于让他们保持“诚实”——是的，2030 年是一个确定的发布日期。
“这中间的尺度很难把握，因为你想进行预热，我们想说，‘嘿，这是我们想要达到的目标，’”Hay 解释道。“我之所以喜欢一个确切的日期，是因为现实情况是它设定了一个目标。它让我们能告诉团队，这就是我们的目标。这是一种号召力，我们正专注于此。我们想确保交付一些有趣、强大且允许玩家探索的内容。但我也喜欢这种能让我们保持诚实的框架。它告诉我们，‘2030 年，出发吧。’”
当被问及 2030 年是否是一个确切的日期时，Hay 确认这确实是“确定的”。
“我喜欢这种能让我们保持诚实的框架。”
虽然 Hay 无法透露这款游戏已经开发了多久，但他分享了团队如何努力将 星际争霸 转化为一个充满活力的宇宙，既能让新玩家感到亲切，又能让老玩家一眼认出。
“我无法告诉你团队开发了多久，但我可以告诉你它在我脑海中酝酿了多久，大概有 25 年了，”他开玩笑说。“对我们来说，我认为重要的是我们找到了真正热爱这个品牌的人。我们找到了了解这个品牌的人，他们回来后能真正感受到对这份传承的热爱。我们费尽心思，精心制作了一些感觉很真实的东西，当你在这个世界中行走时，你会认出它来。”
“这是一件棘手的事情，就像在刀刃上行走。你想要构建一些让新玩家感到亲切和有吸引力的东西，但又要确保它感觉真实。当你走进一家酒吧时，感觉就像原版世界里的酒吧。当你遇到玩家和角色并看到他们时，他们拥有武器和盔甲，感觉很地道，很真实。”
Hay 接着暗示了玩家在这款新作中可以期待的内容，他表示 星际争霸 将重点展示其世界的残酷边缘，以及作为一名士兵对抗巨大致命生物的切身感受。
“我们想展示那里是粗犷的，是一个艰难的世界，充满了战争、不同的阵营和不同的人群，他们并不总是和睦相处，我们想从一开始就体现这一点，”他告诉我们。
“当你思考 星际争霸 能让你做什么，以及我们如何讲述这个故事时——这就是讲述那个故事的方式。脚踏实地，深入泥泞和尘土，感受其中的紧张感。”
“有些东西非常震撼——我得小心别透露太多——我记得第一次看到一只 10 英尺高的刺蛇，它基本上是在向我扑来。我手里拿着枪，穿着盔甲，感觉自己就在泥土里，感受到了它的分量。Emily 刚才提到了兵营的部署。最震撼的地方在于，当你降落在地面上的那一刻，你的视角就改变了。你不再感觉自己是一个俯视这一切、超然世外的神。你会觉得，‘天哪，我就在其中。每一个决定都很重要。我做的每一件事都很有分量。’”
“每一个决定都很重要。我做的每一件事都很有分量。”
他还深入探讨了为什么暴雪选择让 星际争霸 走向如此不同的方向，而不是坚持该系列的即时战略根基——在此过程中，他透露了一些可能的关键游戏元素，其中之一就是利用敌人作为对抗另一个敌人的“工具”。
“对我们来说，当我们思考主题时，我们想到玩家置身战场、观察远景的机会，探索、发现然后破坏的机会。这是非常独特的。当你想到现有的不同阵营时，我们只是想让人们走进这些世界，真正感受一下遇到这些不同群体的感觉。”
“同样，我很想聊聊这些东西，但我必须保留一些，但真正重要的是你思考 星际争霸 中一些不同的阵营，思考他们带来了什么，思考那种感觉。我现在脑子里有一些画面，我得小心描述，但我看到了大量的生物质，我看到了很多我们暗示过的东西。如果你看预告片，开始看到兵营飞入的那一刻，你看向那个星球，你实际上会看到那个星球上所有活着的东西，并感受到那种氛围。”
“对我们来说，把你放在正在战斗且意见不合的人群中间是正确的。这种‘敌人的敌人就是可以利用的工具’的感觉。我们觉得开放世界以及探索、发现的机会，当然还有破坏和利用敌人对付另一个敌人的机会，感觉非常强大。”
星际争霸 距离发布还有一段时间，但你可以通过我们对开幕式的汇总报道了解暴雪提供的所有其他令人兴奋的消息，并预览目前可以游玩的所有内容。

items.title: 《Overwatch》公开新智械英雄首个外观，将于今年晚些时候上线

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/LckJxubuclAokFe.png
暴雪在刚刚公布 Doctrine 后，又预告了另一位新的 Overwatch 英雄。
守望先锋
科幻, 第一人称射击, 即时, PK, 动作, FPS, TPS, 竞技, 射击
《守望先锋》(简称OW)是由暴雪娱乐研发的一款第一人称射击游戏，在国服上线之前一直被人们寄予厚望，例如“FPS游戏终于和英雄扮演结合起来”、“手残玩家也能杀人”之类的卖点噱头层出不穷。事实上，《守望先
查看更多 立即下载
就在这款长盛不衰的英雄射击游戏的粉丝们纷纷在社交媒体上庆祝 Overwatch 新的吸血鬼主题支援英雄亮相时，暴雪在其社交媒体页面上发布的一条动态又悄悄带来了一个惊喜。这篇看起来普普通通的帖子展示了 2026 年完整的全新英雄阵容——但是等等，那是谁？

Doctrine 已与喷气背包猫 (Jetpack Cat)、Anran、Emre、Dmon、Mizuki、Shion、Domina 和 Sierra 一同亮相，但在合照的最右侧，出现了一个从未有人见过的角色。事实证明，这张图片首次展示了一位尚未命名的智械 (Omnic)，他穿着一件机械风衣，戴着一顶时髦的帽子，还拿着一把似乎是雨伞的武器。目前我们只知道他是第 55 号英雄，并且也是一位支援位英雄，粉丝们理所当然地为这次随意的曝光感到疯狂。
“我太需要这个神秘的福尔摩斯智械了，”一位粉丝说道。
“我只知道他的雨伞会洒下一些治疗水滴，但我没法证明，”另一位粉丝推测道。
“这才是个酷英雄，拿着雨伞武器的智械侦探，冲冲冲，”另一位补充道。
暴雪以往在公布新的 Overwatch 英雄时总是守口如瓶，以前大多只展示剪影。但对于这位未命名的智械以及 2026 年暴雪嘉年华 (BlizzCon 2026)，他们破例了。许多粉丝还注意到，我们在这里看到的方案与今年 2 月的 Spotlight 演示会中最初展示的方案大不相同，尽管他的总体设计似乎保持不变。这也是件好事，因为粉丝们已经非常喜欢他们所看到的了，即使这与预期的不太一样。
“所以为什么他被削弱了？我的智械侦探在哪？”
“对于新英雄来说，这是多么美好的一年啊！”

Overwatch 是 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上大放异彩的几款游戏之一。除了将于 10 月 6 日随 Overwatch Season 5 同步上线的 Doctrine 之外，Dokiwatch 也将回归，暴雪还计划对黑影 (Sombra) 和路霸 (Roadhog) 进行重大重做。游戏总监 Aaron Keller 还预告了团队在 2027 年 2 月的 Spotlight 活动中准备的大动作，承诺他们正“致力于打造巅峰时期的 Overwatch”。
不过目前，我们还需要等待，看看这位智械英雄在阵容中的表现，以及他将如何改变游戏环境 (Meta)。与此同时，你可以查看 2026 年暴雪嘉年华开幕式上宣布的其他所有内容。

items.title: 《魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom》目前评测

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/wVwlSdbuclAohwk.jpg

如果你在 2026 年听到 魔兽争霸3：重制版 推出全新的单人剧情战役感到惊讶——毕竟距离上一部资料片 The Frozen Throne 已经过去了 23 年——那么你可以想象当我在今天惊喜公布并立即发布之前拿到 魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom 时的感受。说实话，能重回这个世界真是太好了，考虑到自 2016 年的 Starcraft II: Nova Covert Ops 以来，暴雪就没给单人 RTS 粉丝提供过任何新内容。这部资料片保留了经典 魔兽争霸3：重制版 的感觉，同时融入了一些新点子，这种味道我可能永远也吃不腻。
魔兽争霸3：重制版
策略, 魔兽, RTS, 即时
这次试玩测试只是暴雪打的一个草稿，给大家看个大概，并不代表最终品质，现在对最终正式版下任何定论都为时尚早，只希望暴雪能用心一点，不要辜负了玩家们长久以来的期望。

在撰写本文时，我只玩了新故事的大约四分之一：包含四个任务的“洛丹伦的最后日子”序章，它本身就非常充实且野心勃勃，以及暴雪声称在 魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom 中总计约 30 小时流程的前三个小时左右。到目前为止，后者确实更倾向于 RPG 玩法，就像 The Frozen Throne 中雷克萨的“多塔隆的成立”奖励战役的加强版。
“洛丹伦的最后日子”从阿尔萨斯从诺森德归来弑父的那一天开始，这也许是整个 Warcraft 传说中最关键的时刻之一。故事追随新英雄——守卫中尉加雷克·班达里恩（Garek Bandarion），他在被围困的安多哈尔和被摧毁的斯坦索姆中奋力拼杀，徒劳地试图从天灾军团手中拯救家园。这个序章以与瑞文戴尔男爵的对决告终，并包含了许多针对 魔兽争霸3：重制版 和 小小魔兽 的巧妙致敬。
小小魔兽
魔幻, 角色扮演, 2D, RPG, 道具收费
查看更多 立即下载
我非常喜欢这些任务的设计。特别是“安多哈尔之围”，它为典型的 魔兽争霸3：重制版 流程加入了一些受 MOBA 启发的改动，你需要占领防御塔，防御塔会定期产生由 AI 控制的友方士兵，帮助你推进地图。同一任务的另一部分要求我占领特定目标才能招募某些兵种，而不仅仅是在基地建造相关建筑。
此时已完成净化后的斯坦索姆，被设计成一个曲折的地牢爬行关卡。

此时已完成净化后的斯坦索姆，被设计成一个曲折的地牢爬行关卡，需要你协调由加雷克领导的一组和由精灵牧师伊拉斯塔·颂风（Ilastar Songbreeze）领导的第二组——如果你能认出这个冷门细节，我给你加 500 分，因为我绝对得去查查他到底是谁，尽管我几乎是吃着、睡着都在钻研 Warcraft 。他们在任务前半段保持分离，这创造了一些有趣的机会，可以用一组完成目标来帮助另一组前进。最后他们在终局会师，进行最后的戏剧性冲锋。
在一个极其明显的转折中，加雷克在与瑞文戴尔的对决中表现不佳，并最终在主战役中作为拥有自由意志的被遗忘者重生。他直接听命于希尔瓦娜斯，并由她的副官黑暗游侠安雅（Anya）陪同。这场自由探索、任务驱动的冒险围绕着在首都废墟下的幽暗城建立被遗忘者势力展开。我们还知道加雷克注定会成为第一位被遗忘者圣骑士——这是一种非正统的组合，很快就可以在 小小魔兽 中玩到——但我还不确定这是如何发生的。

魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom 还为 魔兽争霸3：重制版 带来了一种名为“终极版（Definitive Edition）”选项的第三种全新图形风格。其核心想法是解决人们对 2020 年饱受争议的 魔兽争霸3：重制版: Reforged 更新的抱怨，使 魔兽争霸3：重制版 看起来更细致、更现代，同时保留原版的感觉。起初，我对这个方向并不感冒。老实说，在过场动画中放大看并不好。许多纹理非常平坦、无光泽，甚至看起来像没做完一样。在某些盔甲从阵营蓝色过渡到金属边缘的地方，你可以看到明显的像素点。而且光影效果看起来仍然相当过时。
但当我加载一场针对 AI 的自定义遭遇战时，我突然明白了他们的意图。以快速的节奏缩小视角玩，我几乎忘了我用的不是 2003 年的原版画面。这就像魔术一样。所有的单位和建筑看起来都和我记忆中一样，只是精度更高。我怀疑除了那些最硬核、只爱低多边形的老玩家外，这将成为所有人玩多人模式和自定义游戏的首选方式。

对我来说，这些视觉上的好东西分布得如此不均匀有点令人遗憾。 魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom 战役只能使用终极版图形。好吧，这看起来还算公平。多人模式和遭遇战让你在经典版、 魔兽争霸3：重制版: Reforged 或终极版之间选择。但如果你想重温依然非常出色的 魔兽争霸3：混乱之治 和 The Frozen Throne 战役——你真的应该去重温！——它们只支持经典版或 魔兽争霸3：重制版: Reforged ，不支持终极版。
不幸的是，新的视觉效果分布得如此不均匀。
另一个重要的补充，也是对多人模式产生重大影响的补充，是 魔兽争霸3：重制版 自 2004 年加入炼金术士和火焰领主以来的第一位新酒馆英雄。这就是被遗忘者圣骑士，当然是以加雷克为原型的。他在主题定位上有点尴尬。毕竟，已经有了人族圣骑士英雄，而死亡骑士最初的设计就是他的反面镜像。那么被遗忘者圣骑士的定位在哪里呢？

嗯，他是一个亡灵中立英雄，却只能治疗活物，所以讽刺的是，他对亡灵玩家来说可能是最没用的。他的 Q 技能是一个冲刺，穿过的敌人越多伤害越高，所以他的机动性很强。作为一名力量型英雄，他在近战中非常致命。他的 W 技能对于任何玩过 小小魔兽 圣骑士的人来说都很熟悉——奉献，它会对脚下小圆圈内的亡灵敌人造成伤害，并治疗友方活物单位。他还有一个被动光环，可以减少受到的魔法伤害并增加受到的治疗效果。他的大招是一个群体驱散/晕眩，可以治疗附近的友方单位，如果驱散移除了减益效果，还会提供额外的治疗和短暂的伤害加成。这绝对可以对某些战术产生强力克制，我很想看看职业选手对他有什么看法。
我还应该提到，所有游戏模式中的编队单位数量都翻了一倍。对于这样一款经典游戏来说，这是一个大胆的改变，我确信老玩家们会对此颇有微词。但从我这个硬核玩家的角度来看，我认为这总体上是一个积极的改变。
请在未来几周关注我对 魔兽争霸3：重制版 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom 的最终评测，届时我将有机会通关整个战役。

items.title: 《X战警2：狼人复仇》影星 Inde Navarrette 透露她将如何精准拿捏“罗刹女”的南方口音

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/xQBxhxbuclxarDF.png
《致命诱惑》的突破性影星 Inde Navarrette 已经有了一个计划，以确保她在新的 X战警2：狼人复仇 电影中完美诠释小淘气（Rogue）标志性的南方口音。
Navarrette 将从恐怖片跨越到漫威电影宇宙 (MCU)，出演将于 2028 年上映的 X战警2：狼人复仇。正如上个月所透露的，该片定于 2028 年 5 月 5 日上映。除了小淘气窃取超能力的能力和凶悍的态度外，粉丝们一直渴望知道 Navarrette 是否会为小淘气的配音增添些许风味。
这个角色以其南方口音而闻名，尤其是得益于初代 X战警2：狼人复仇 动画系列配音演员 Lenore Zann 所普及的表现方式。Navarrette 可能没有观众所期待的小淘气那种自然的口音，但她在接受《今夜娱乐》采访时表示，这位变种人团队成员的声音已经在她的考虑之中了。
“我从未公开说过这件事——我都完全忘了——但我来自一个离异家庭。我生命中的大部分时间都在德克萨斯州长大，”当被问及将如何塑造小淘气的声音时，Navarrette 说道，“所以，老实说，那些南方女性真的是我的最爱。”
Navarrette 随后提到了她与科珀斯克里斯蒂（Corpus Christi）的特殊联系，那是德克萨斯州南部的一个沿海小镇。对于这位从《致命诱惑》女演员转型为漫威超级英雄的艺人来说，她“非常非常喜欢”那些“老派的南方女性”。但她对南方的喜爱不止于此。
“但具体来说，是密西西比州——小淘气来自密西西比州，”她继续说道，“所以，我真的很想去那里。我想真正地还原这个角色。”
Navarrette 只是宏大 MCU 拼图中的一员。已确认出演 MCU X战警2：狼人复仇 重启电影的演员还包括：亚当·德赖弗饰演惊恶先生，玛雅·博伊德饰演暴风女，克里斯托弗·阿波特饰演 X教授，萨迪·辛克饰演琴·葛蕾，基特·康纳饰演镭射眼，以及萨玛拉·维文饰演白皇后。《V 世代》和《惊声尖叫 7》的明星阿萨·格尔曼最近也被选中饰演长有翅膀的变种人天使。
在 X战警2：狼人复仇 上映之前，还有许多其他环节需要整合，但导演杰克·施莱尔预告了一部值得期待的团队电影。今年 8 月，他谈到了他正在寻找灵感的一些漫画书，承诺将为 MCU 粉丝带来一部与以往真人版 X战警2：狼人复仇 电影截然不同的“全新视角”作品。与此同时，据报道 Navarrette 对参演这部电影感到非常兴奋，以至于她放弃了在《烈火悍将 2》中的角色。

Diablo 迎来 30 周年，庇护之地沦陷
Diablo V 将于 2029 年春季推出，它开启了该系列从未涉足的领域：在失败之后。庇护之地已经沦陷，Diablo 赢了。游戏提出的核心问题是，当我们的世界消逝时，我们会变成什么样？
近一点来说， Diablo IV 的 Diablo IV: Season of Hell’s Legacy 将于 9 月 15 日（就是下周二！）上线，以纪念 Diablo 系列诞生 30 周年。它将带回包括恐惧之王在内的三大恶魔，以及迪卡·凯恩、梦魇秘境、周年纪念奖励以及从系列各个时代提取的装备。
再往后看，亚马逊战士作为 Diablo IV 的下一个职业，将于 2027 年上半年加入游戏，手持标枪登场。如果你在现场或在家中游玩，会发现莫菲斯托已经回归，继续恐吓毫无防备的人们。他依然和你记忆中一样，令人毛骨悚然。呵呵。

《无主之地4》在 Steam 排行榜上攀升，玩家们正疯狂迷恋其新的 DLC 角色——一位名叫“黑客 Loveless”的秘藏猎人。

查看更多 立即下载
Gearbox Software 的最新作《无主之地4》在 2025 年 9 月发布后的几个月里表现挣扎。尽管创下了该掠夺射击系列史上规模最大的首发纪录，但 PC 和主机平台的技术问题，以及 Gearbox 对局势的处理，导致玩家数量随即急剧下降。SteamDB 的数据显示，自今年 1 月以来，其同时在线玩家数一直难以突破 1 万名。
虽然《无主之地4》在发布时获得了普遍好评，但直到现在才重新激起玩家的兴趣。9 月 10 日周五，拥有高端控制论装备的 DLC 角色“黑客 Loveless”正式发布。她只是更宏大的 Story Pack 2 发布内容的一小部分，但她似乎为游戏带来了第二次生命。
“Loveless 体内存在着两个意识，形成了一套同步的致命技能，如同一体般发起攻击，”Loveless 的描述中写道，“通过生物与数字的共生融合，这位前 Anshin 黑客转型的刺客已进化为更高级的生命形式。装备着最高端的控制论插件，Loveless 与她亲手创造的数字病毒共享精神，该病毒可以数码构造成物理形态的‘龙兽（Wyrm）’，作为她追求完美的共同意志的致命延伸。”
截至本文发表时，《无主之地4》仅在 Steam 平台上就拥有约 26,000 名同时在线玩家。这是自 2025 年 11 月以来的最高值，远高于 3 月份 Story Pack 1 发布时达到的 17,000 名玩家峰值。基础游戏目前也成功跻身美国 Steam 销量排行榜前 5 名，在全球前 10 名榜单中位列第 9。
玩家人数似乎还在进一步攀升，Steam 评论区的玩家特别提到 Loveless 是他们决定重返 Kairos 星球的原因。许多人指出女演员 Carin Gilfry 的配音是一个亮点，但你大概也能猜到其他人的评价。
“单纯为了 Loveless 买的这款游戏，”一条评论写道，“这才是营销之道。”
“实际上是个不错的角色，”一条热门评论说道，“外观漂亮，设计出色，而且强得离谱（可以独自挑战 Boss）。但她的可选头部外观有点……一般。而且她售价 9.99 美元。不过配音演员确实很卖力。总的来说，我觉得她很合适。”
“允许我在不购买 DLC 故事包的情况下单独购买秘藏猎人是正确的决定，”另一位粉丝表示，他指的是 Loveless 10 美元的售价，而与之相对的是最近发布的 Story Pack 2 扩展包。“很高兴他们吸取了教训。另外，妈妈踩我。”

目前尚不清楚这些数字是否能维持下去，但对《无主之地4》来说，这似乎是一个大获全胜的周末。欲了解更多信息，您可以阅读母公司 Take-Two 对进入市场第二年的 Gearbox 最新作的评价。您还可以阅读有关 Saber 如何挖苦 Gearbox 首席执行官 Randy Pitchford 的内容。

事实上，这是一个完全不同的游戏类型。星际争霸 是一款开放世界射击游戏，预计将于 2030 年发售。虽然如此遥远的发售窗口让人很难立即对 星际争霸 感到兴奋，但暴雪在游戏准备好面向公众之前很久就公布游戏的做法早有先例。事实上，这家开发了 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 的公司在这方面“声名在外”，历史上一直信奉着这样一条准则：“准备好时自然会发布（It’ll be ready when it’s ready）。”
在 星际争霸 官方网站出现大量视觉“故障”并发布“警告”称用户设备已“受损”后，人们就预料到暴雪嘉年华上会公布 星际争霸 系列新作。粉丝们认为这意味着该系列即将迎来重大更新，事实证明他们是对的。
事实上，有关 星际争霸 射击游戏的传闻已经流传多年。2024 年，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 透露了暴雪正尝试第三次开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的消息，由 2022 年加入暴雪的前 孤岛惊魂：新的曙光 执行制作人 Dan Hay 负责领导。随后在 2024 年晚些时候，一份针对“即将推出的开放世界射击游戏”的招聘信息发布，粉丝们确信这与这款 星际争霸 游戏有关。
多年来，暴雪在开发 星际争霸 射击游戏方面历经坎坷。2002 年公布的 星际争霸 Ghost 原本是一款战术动作主机游戏，玩家在其中扮演受雇于泰伦帝国的致命幽灵特工，但在经历了一系列跳票后，该项目于 2006 年被取消。
第二次尝试开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的代号为 阿瑞斯：守护者崛起，但该项目在 2019 年被取消，以便暴雪能专注于 暗黑破坏岛 4 和 Overwatch 2。据报道，阿瑞斯：守护者崛起 “就像是 星际争霸 宇宙版的 《Battlefield 3™》”，但和 星际争霸 Ghost 一样，最终半途而废。
现在，随着这款正在开发的新 星际争霸 射击游戏的出现，暴雪或许能迎来“事不过三”的好运。

“当 Level-5 宣布带着 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产、DecaPolice、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 等作品强势回归时，我非常兴奋，”一位社交媒体用户表示。“但看到这么多明目张胆的生成式 AI 被应用在他们的游戏中……是的，这不对劲。”
“你们曾是一家出色的工作室，”另一位粉丝说道。“现在你们对我们来说不过是令人失望。我们不想要这些 AI 垃圾。”
Level-5 社长兼 CEO 日野晃博也以自己的动画形象主持了这场发布会，他在社交平台上发文安抚舆论。他的信息既是道歉也是解释，确认了 Level-5 确实在开发的某些方面使用了生成式 AI。
日野将 Level-5 大量使用 AI 描述为“对最新技术的实验”，并补充说团队“向任何对此感到不适的人表示诚挚的歉意”。
“我原本对 DecaPolice 很感兴趣，但 Level-5 使用 AI 的行为让我感到恶心。我无法支持这一点。”
“但是，请放心，定义我们已发布作品魅力和个性的所有元素——如剧本、角色设计和基础设定——完全是由人手创作的，”日野表示。“我们主要利用 AI 来简化人造资产的数字化过程；例如，将原始艺术稿准确转换为 3D 多边形模型。您可以放心，我们发行的游戏不包含纯粹由 AI 生成的内容。”
日野还为 Level-5 目前使用 AI 的方式辩护，称：“通过 AI 驱动的效率提升所节省的时间，让我们的创作者能够将更多精力投入到真正的创意核心中。”对于他和团队其他成员来说，他们相信 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 等游戏的最终版本最终仍会令粉丝满意。这次如此依赖生成式 AI 的部分原因是希望能将“大作的开发周期从目前的五年缩短到两年”。
“尽管如此，我们不能否认这次广泛使用了 AI，这是出于希望呈现一个视觉冲击力强且易于理解的演示文档的渴望，”他继续说道。“我们将把这次经历作为未来的学习机会，所以请期待 Level-5 的下一次发布会。”
这一解释在 Level-5 社区反响不佳。帖子的回复中，粉丝们仍对开发过程中使用生成技术感到担忧，担心受影响的游戏将永远留下污点。
“生成式 AI 是科技公司利用无数艺术家被盗的作品进行训练以谋取利益的，其目的是取代艺术家，”一条热门回复称。“通过使用它，你们取代了艺术家。你们正在利用那些为了驱动该软件而被盗用的艺术家的技能获利。”
“我相信人心比上市速度更重要；不使用 AI 耗时五年肯定更好，”另一条日文帖子写道。“如果哪怕只有一个资产是用 AI 创建的，‘这个图像、这段音乐或这段对话是 AI 还是人类创作的？’这种挥之不去的担忧就永远不会消失。维护这种信任难道不是最重要的吗？”
日野没有就 Level-5 未来将如何调整开发计划提供具体的方案。目前，2007 年原版游戏的重制版 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 计划于 2027 年登陆 PC 和主机。该系列的另一款新作 the New World of Steam 将于今年 12 月发售。

content.v: 暴雪宣布 《 暗黑破坏神4 》将迎来全新赛季、亚马逊职业包等内容。新职业亚马逊 将于2027年上半年加入，这一经典职业能够使用弓，并将带来全新的标枪武器类型。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789260757_997163_jpg_r.jpg
《憎恨之王》的故事将前往斯科沃斯，但亚马逊战士此前并未与回归的圣骑士及新职业术士一同亮相。随着相关内容推进，玩家开始询问这一源自《 暗黑 破坏神2》的职业何时回归。
《暗黑破坏神4》高级游戏总监Brent Gibson表示，团队在制作《憎恨之王》期间逐步确定了亚马逊战士的设计方向，并认为这是不能错过的机会。他将该职业描述为擅长速度、精准打击和战场控制的战士。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789260758_454118.jpg
在亚马逊战士登场前，《暗黑破坏神4》还将于9月15日（周二）推出第15赛季——30周年纪念内容“地狱遗产赛季”。15赛季会让包括恐惧之王迪亚波罗在内的三大魔神回归，迪卡德·凯恩也将现身，奖励则包含以系列各个时期为灵感设计的装备。
赛季任务要求玩家击败迪亚波罗、巴尔和墨菲斯托的回响，收集三枚邪恶碎片。玩家可以选择携带其中一枚，使对应魔神的标志性力量在战斗中周期性爆发，但也会更容易受到其影响。邪恶碎片可通过特定活动升级，并能随时更换。

content.v: 在暴雪嘉年华上，暴雪闪电公布了《 暗黑 破坏神5》，宣布将于2029年春季发售，故事发生在迪亚波罗获胜后，描绘庇护之地已经陷落的世界。
更重要的是，暴雪还公布了首批职业，包括再次登场的猎魔人和武僧，以及系列首次出现的瘟疫骑士。暴雪表示，游戏首发时提供的职业数量也将超过历代作品。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789260164_860260_jpg_r.jpg
游戏总监乔·谢利将瘟疫骑士形容为一个“身披重甲”的职业，同时也是游荡于世界的“行走之死”。该职业能够散播疾病，再将其吸收并转化为自身力量。
谢利确认，《暗黑破坏神5》的首发职业不仅会比系列任何一部作品首发时更多，其数量还将超过历代单部作品最终拥有的职业总数。具体的完整职业阵容尚未公布。
他表示，各职业会保留容易上手的特点，让玩家可以迅速体验战斗，同时提供足够深入的动作角色扮演玩法，并支持多种流派构筑。目前已确认的首批阵容为猎魔人、武僧和瘟疫骑士。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260913/1789259765_132552_jpg_r.jpg
关于《暗黑破坏神5》
《暗黑破坏神5》描述恐惧之王归来，迪亚波罗已征服圣休亚瑞并统治卫斯马屈，以当地的人与灵魂为武器发动永恒之战。他不再是位于故事尽头的遥远威胁，迪亚波罗将从故事的开端左右剧情发展、世界的样貌，以及玩家一路走来的冒险。
玩家将扮演失落之国卫斯马屈的继承者，穿越这个已被迪亚波罗化为地狱前哨站的王国焦土，踏上逃亡之路。与迪亚布罗之间的神秘连结，使这位继承者既是威胁，却又格外容易受其影响。然而在五代中，圣休亚瑞已经全面崩坏，西方大陆座落于迪亚布罗暴政的中心，整个世界动荡不安。迪亚波罗正透过恐惧重塑世界，每当玩家重返此地，眼前的地形、重要地点、怪物，以及奖励都会有所改变。
当玩家失去城镇与要塞后，为求生存必须打造出一支载满盟友的拖车，一起在这个破败不堪的世界中踏上旅途。这些伙伴同时也是商人，每个人都背负着自己的故事，其中包含一名前目盲之眼姐妹会的成员，以及一个受困的盗宝哥布林。
《暗黑破坏神5》也将带来猎魔人、武僧及全新的瘟疫骑士，官方宣称这是预计推出的众多职业中，首批公开的职业。至于游戏也将有灵感源自于《暗黑破坏神2》的物品系统，装备会出现属性需求，大型物品将占据更多物品栏空间，还有各种回归功能，例如符文、符文之语以及套装等，让打宝过程简单易懂、深刻难忘，并且值回票价。
官方表示，《暗黑破坏神5》仍处于早期开发阶段、尚未公布平台。从2027年起，开发团队预计在游戏成形的过程中，定期更新进度、设计理念等。

content.v: 在暴雪嘉年华2026上，暴雪正式公布了《魔兽世界：Forever》（World of Warcraft: Forever），这是他们对社区长期呼吁的“怀旧服+”版本的官方回应。该版本将于2026年11月4日正式上线。
视频：
据官方介绍，《魔兽世界：Forever》将带来大量新内容，包括：
新地下城
10人与20人团队副本
可玩新种族“天空精灵”（Skyborne elves）
新的与扩展的区域
账号通用福利
更新的世界视觉与光照效果
新的种族与职业组合
超过1000个新任务
《Forever》重制了三个经典区域，并新增三个区域，同时加入三个新团本、一个新战场。该版本存在于一个类似“时间气泡”的框架中，暴雪计划以横向方式持续扩展60级体验，不断添加新团本、任务与内容，而非纵向提升等级。
目前尚不清楚该版本是否与当前《魔兽世界》正式服处于不同时间线。
《魔兽世界：Forever》将于六周后正式上线，玩家很快就能亲自体验这一经典+版本。

items.summary: We got the chance to speak with the developers of the new StaCcraft game, who explained why they shared such a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/starcraft-dev-interview-blizzcon-2026-1789253765891.jpg

We got the chance to speak with the developers of the new StarCraft game, who explained why they shared such a distant release date and even teased some potential gameplay elements for this highly-anticipated title.

StarCraft is finally getting a new game, and it’s taking a drastically different approach from its predecessors; instead of an RTS, Blizzard’s grisly sci-fi property is making its debut in the realm of open-world shooters, and it’s set to launch in 2030.

That’s a long way out from now, and it’s anyone’s guess as to what the world will look like in four years. We got the chance to ask the developers everyone’s burning question at Blizzcon 2026: Why announce the game if there’s still so much time left before it releases?
Dan Hay, GM & VP of StarCraft and AnaLee Haertling, Associate Director, told us that sharing a firm release date helps keep them “honest” — and yes, 2030 is a firm release date.

“You walk a funny line, because it’s like, you wanna tease, and we wanna say, ‘Hey, this is where we wanna land,’” Hay explained. “The reason why I love a really good date, is because the reality is that it puts a target. It allows us to say to a team that that’s what we’re going for. It’s a rallying cry, and we’re focused on that. We wanna make sure we deliver something that is fun, something that is powerful, and something that allows you to explore. But I also like the idea that there’s a frame that keeps us honest. And it says, ‘2030, let’s go.’”
When asked if 2030 was a solid date, Hay confirmed that it is, indeed, “solid.”

While Hay couldn’t tell us how long the game has been in development, he did share some insight into how hard the team is working to transform StarCraft into a world that feels like a living, breathing universe that’s both welcoming to new players and recognizable to longtime fans.

“I can’t tell you how long it’s been in development with the team, but I can tell you how long it’s been in development in my head, and it’s probably about 25 years,” he joked. “For us, I think what’s important is that we've gone out to find people who really love the brand. We’ve gone out to people who know the brand, who come back and really feel the love of the legacy. We’ve taken great pains and great care to make something that feels authentic, that when you walk through this world, you recognize it.

“It's a tricky thing. It’s a bit of a knife’s edge. You wanna build something that is welcoming and inviting to new players but you wanna make sure it feels real. That when you walk into a bar it feels like a bar from the original world. When you meet players and characters and you see them, they've got the weapons and the armor and it feels authentic and it feels real.”

Hay went on to drop a few subtle hints at what players can expect in this new game, saying that StarCraft will bring into sharp focus the rough edges of its world, along with the visceral feeling of being a soldier fighting against massive, deadly creatures.

“We wanna show that it’s rough tools out there, it's a difficult world, it's filled with warfare and different factions and different groups of people, and they don’t always get along, and we wanted to bring that to bear from the very beginning,” he told us.

“When you think about what StarCraft will allow you to do, and we thought about how we tell this story — this is the way to tell that story. To be boots on the ground, to be down in the muck and the dirt, and to feel the tension of it.

“There was something really powerful — and I have to be careful not to give too much away here — I remember seeing the first time that a Hydralisk was 10 feet tall, and it was basically snapping at me. And I’ve got a gun and I’ve got armor, and I’m feeling like I’m down in the dirt and I’m feeling the weight of it. Emily was just talking about the deployment of the barracks. What’s super powerful about it is the moment you drop down on the ground, your perspective changes. It doesn’t feel like you’re a god looking down at this and you’re detached. It feels like, ‘My God, I'm in the middle of this. Every decision matters. Everything I do feels like it has gravitas.’”

He also dove into why Blizzard chose to take StarCraft in such a wildly different direction, rather than staying with the series’ RTS roots — and in doing so, shed some light on a few possible key gameplay elements, one of which is using an enemy as a “tool” against another enemy.

“For us, when we think about the themes and we think about the opportunity for you to be on the battlefield and for you to go out and think about the vista, the opportunity to explore, and then to discover, and then to disrupt. It’s incredibly unique. And then when you think about the different factions that there are, we just wanted people to go out into these worlds and actually get a sense of what it’s like to meet these different groups.

“Again, I really wanna talk about this stuff, but I also have to hold some stuff back, but what's really important is you think about some of these different factions in StarCraft, and you think about what they bring and you think about the way that it feels. I have imagery in my head right now that I can be careful not to describe, but I’m seeing an awful lot of biomass, and I’m seeing a lot of stuff we were hinting at. If you look at the teaser and you start to see that moment where the barracks is flying in and you look at the planet, you’ll actually see all the things that are alive on that planet and get a sense of that feel.

“For us, it felt right to put you down on the ground in the middle of people that are fighting and they don’t agree. This feeling of, ‘The enemy of my enemy is a tool to be used.’ We felt like the open world and the opportunity to explore and to discover and of course to disrupt and to use my enemy against another enemy felt really powerful.”

StarCraft is still a ways out, but you can catch up on all the other exciting news Blizzard had to offer in our round-up blog for the event's Opening Ceremony and take a peek at everything that's available to play right now.

items.summary: The Diablo team is "all focused on seasons and getting to Diablo 5," support for Diablo 4 will continue "for a

content.v: Diablo is returning: At BlizzCon today, Blizzard announced that Diablo 5 will be set a century after Diablo 4 in a Sanctuary that has succumbed to the Lord of Terror, Diablo himself.
That's not until 2029, though. In the meantime, Blizzard will continue the story of Diablo 4 with seasons, but no more expansions are currently planned for the game.

"We're all focused on [Diablo 4] seasons and getting to Diablo 5," said Diablo game director Brent Gibson in an interview with PC Gamer at BlizzCon. "We feel like we told the Story of Hatred. We had a great conclusion with Lord of Hatred with what we have with Mephisto, and we are moving towards telling the Story of Terror."

Even if no more expansions are currently planned, the Diablo 4 story isn't over. Given the premise of Diablo 5, Blizzard now has to bring about the apocalypse, and it sounds like we'll see how that plays out in the upcoming seasons. Nothing's set in stone, though.

"The events of Diablo 5 happen 100 years after everything that's happening with Diablo 4, and so that gives us a lot of room to kind of still ride the wave with all the fans on where the story can go as we make our way there," said Gibson. "So continuity is something that we're really excited about, but we don't necessarily have a perfect picture on exactly where that's going to go because we want to see how fans are reacting season to season."

I also asked whether we can expect a Path of Exile/Path of Exile 2 situation, where a live service game and its sequel end up running concurrently, or if we should expect dev resources to fully switch over to Diablo 5 after it launches.

Gibson indicated that support for Diablo 4 isn't going away so long as people are playing it, pointing to the continued support for Diablo 2 Resurrected, which got a new class earlier this year, as evidence of Blizzard's commitment to the whole Diablo "universe."
"I think you can expect that—you know, Diablo 4 players, they love the game, there's tons of them out there," said Gibson. "We're continuing to support the game for a very long time."

It's unclear what that support will look like, but Diablo 5 is a ways off yet and it sounds like plans are expected to evolve with feedback. Diablo 3 won't necessarily be the template followed, but it's currently in a kind of time loop, cycling through its biggest seasons.

items.summary: A surprise single-player campaign that maintains the feel of classic Warcraft 3 while mixing in some new ideas

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/warcraft-3-expansion-blogroll-1789246436615.jpg

If you're a bit stunned to hear that there's a new single-player story campaign for Warcraft 3 in 2026 – 23 years after its last expansion, The Frozen Throne – then you can imagine how I felt when Forsaken Kingdom fell into my hands ahead of its surprise announcement and immediate release today. It's honestly great to be back, considering Blizzard hasn't given single-player RTS fans anything new to chew on at all since 2016's Starcraft II: Nova Covert Ops. This expansion maintains the feel of classic Warcraft 3 while mixing in some new ideas, and that's something I might never run out of appetite for.

At the time of writing, I've only had the chance to play through maybe a quarter of the new story: the four-mission Last Days of Lordaeron prologue, which is quite juicy and ambitious on its own, as well as the first three or so hours of what Blizzard says is roughly 30 total in Forsaken Kingdom. The latter really leans into being an RPG so far, like a more ambitious version of Rexxar's Founding of Durotar bonus campaign in The Frozen Throne.

The Last Days of Lordaeron picks up on the day Arthas returned from Northrend to kill his father, perhaps one of the most pivotal moments in all of Warcraft lore, and follows the new hero, guard lieutenant Garek Bandarion, as he fights his way through a besieged Andorhal and a devastated Strathholme in a doomed attempt to save his homeland from the Scourge. This prologue culminates with a confrontation against none other than Baron Rivendare, and contains numerous clever little references to both Warcraft 3 and World of Warcraft.

I enjoyed the design of these missions for the most part. The Siege of Andorhal, especially, puts a little bit of a MOBA-inspired twist on the typical Warcraft 3 routine by having you capture towers that spawn waves of AI-controlled friendly soldiers at regular intervals to help you push across the map. Another segment of the same mission required me to hold specific objectives to be able to recruit certain kinds of units, rather than simply needing their associated structure in my base.

Stratholme, post-purge at this point, is built like a winding dungeon crawl that requires you to coordinate one group led by Garek and a second led by the elven priest Ilastar Songbreeze – 500 bonus points if you recognize that deep cut, because I definitely had to look up who the heck he was and I practically eat, sleep, and breathe Warcraft. They remain separated for the first half of the mission, which created some interesting opportunities to use one group to complete an objective that helped the other progress. They then unite at the end for the final, dramatic push.

In an extremely heavily-telegraphed twist, Garek doesn't fare well in his confrontation with Rivendare, and ends up raised as one of the free-willed Forsaken in the main campaign. Taking his orders directly from Sylvanas and accompanied by her lieutenant, the Dark Ranger Anya, this free-roaming, quest-driven adventure revolves around establishing the Forsaken in the Undercity beneath the capital ruins. We also know Garek is destined to become the first Forsaken Paladin – an unorthodox combo that is soon to be playable in World of Warcraft – but I'm not sure how this transpires just yet.
What I said about Warcraft 3: Reforged

Warcraft 3 is still probably my favorite Warcraft game of all time, and one of my favorite fantasy stories in any video game. The visual update Reforged brings to all its beloved and behated characters is all the reason I needed to want to experience it again. It’s not perfect, and it’s not everything we may have been promised, but it’s still Warcraft 3. If I were judging it purely based on how good of a remaster it is, there’s not much to write home about and plenty of room for improvement. But taken as a whole, it’s still a great game nearly two decades after its initial release. And the relatively minor shortcomings of this edition shouldn’t stop you from returning to this classic age of Azeroth or diving in for the first time. - Len Hafer, February 5, 2020
Score: 7
Read the full Warcraft 3: Reforged review .

Forsaken Kingdom also comes with a third, entirely new graphical style for Warcraft 3 called the "Definitive Edition" option. The idea was to address the complaints people had about 2020's divisive Reforged update, making Warcraft 3 look a bit more detailed and modern while preserving the feel of the original. At first, I wasn't super impressed with this direction. It doesn't look great zoomed in during cutscenes, to be honest. A lot of the textures are extremely flat, matte, and almost unfinished-looking. You can see visible pixels on some of the armor where it transitions from the faction blue to the metallic edging. And the lighting still comes off as pretty dated.

But when I loaded into a custom skirmish match against AI, I suddenly saw what they were going for. Playing zoomed out at a fast pace, I almost forgot I wasn't using the original 2003 graphics. It's like a magic trick. All the units and buildings look like how I remember them, just with higher fidelity. I suspect this will become the preferred way to play multiplayer and custom games for all but the most die-hard, low-polygon grognards.

It's a bit unfortunate to me, then, that these visual goodies are so unevenly distributed. The Forsaken Kingdom campaign can only be played with the Definitive Edition graphics. And, you know, that seems fair enough. Multiplayer and skirmish let you pick between Classic, Reforged, or Definitive Edition. But if you want to revisit the still frankly superb Reign of Chaos and Frozen Throne campaigns – and you really should! – they only support Classic or Reforged, not Definitive.

The other significant addition, and the one with a big impact on multiplayer, is Warcraft 3's first new tavern hero since the Alchemist and Firelord were added in 2004. This is the Forsaken Paladin, based on Garek of course. He's in a bit of a strange thematic spot. After all, there's already the Human Paladin hero, and the Death Knight was originally designed as sort of a negative mirror image of that. So where does that leave the Forsaken Paladin? Well, he is an undead neutral hero who can only heal the living, so he might be the least useful to Undead players, ironically. His Q ability is a dash that does more damage the more enemies it passes through, so he's quite mobile. As a strength hero, he is deadly in melee. His W is familiar to anyone who has played a WoW paladin with Consecration, which damages undead enemies and heals friendly living units in a small circle at his feet. He also has a passive aura that reduces magic damage taken and increases healing received. And his ult is an AoE purge/stun that heals nearby friendly units, with bonus healing and a short damage buff if the purge removed a debuff from them. This could definitely have some strong counterplay against certain builds, and I'm interested to see what pro players think of him.

I should also mention that the number of units in a control group has been doubled across all game modes. It's an ambitious change for a legacy game like this, and one I'm sure the old guard will groan about. But I think it's a positive one overall, from my spot down here in the tryhard seats.

Blizzard has teased another new Overwatch Hero after revealing Doctrine just moments ago.

Just as fans of the long-running hero shooter took to social media to celebrate the reveal of Overwatch's new vampire-themed Support Hero, Blizzard snuck in another surprise with a post on its social media page. What seemed to be an innocent enough post showed off the full new Hero roster for 2026 – but wait, who's that?

Doctrine has joined Jetpack Cat, Anran, Emre, Dmon, Mizuki, Shion, Domina, and Sierra, but tucked in the far-right side of the group photo is a character no one has ever seen before. It turns out the image included a first look at a yet-to-be-named Omnic with a robotic trench coat, a swanky hat, and what seems to be an umbrella weapon. All we know for now is that he is Hero 55 and he's another Support, and fans, of course, are losing their minds at the nonchalant reveal.

Blizzard has previously kept its cards close to its chest when it came to new Overwatch Hero reveals, mostly limiting designs to silhouettes, previously. For this unnamed Omnic and for BlizzCon 2026, it's made an exception. Many fans have also noted that the design we see here is far different from the one we were originally shown at the Spotlight presentation in February of this year, though it appears his general design has remained intact. It's a good thing, too, because fans already really like what they see, even if it's not quite what was expected.

items.summary: Blizzard has revealed three classes for Diablo 5, a first look at its UI, and shown off even more as part of i

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/blizzcon-2026-main-stage-diablo-v-forging-the-next-era-4-50-12-screenshot-1789251095454.png
Blizzard has revealed three classes for Diablo 5, a first look at its UI, and shown off even more as part of its Forging the Next Era panel at BlizzCon 2026 .

The next Diablo game might be years away from its spring 2029 launch, but that didn't stop some members of the development team from confirming the first details. Highlights from the 45-minute panel include confirmation that the Demon Hunter and Monk are two returning classes, but a new class is coming too: the Plague Knight.

Concept art, gameplay details, and more were all revealed as part of the big panel presentation. Blizzard also talked about why it decided to make the announcement now, almost three years before launch. We gathered all of the highlights for newcomers and die-hard fans to comb through right here. You can see everything announced at the Diablo 5 BlizzCon panel below.
The Diablo Team Takes the Stage

Multiple members from the Diablo team have taken the stage at BlizzCon 2026. After the surprise reveal for Diablo 5, it's clear the developers have a lot to talk about. Shely said the plan is for the panel to cover the story, world, gameplay, and even some information about itemization.
"We're a long way from the campfire, from its comfort and hope. These are the fires of Diablo. Sanctuary has been destroyed, and Diablo has won," Shely said.
A New Dark Lord

Producer Matt Zitterman said, when deciding how to approach more Diablo, Blizzard first had to decide whether to do more DLC or another mainline entry. When looking at Diablo 4 and an opportunity to bring back the true Diablo, a proper sequel with Diablo 5 is the only thing that really made sense.

"Once we decided that this game was going to bring Diablo back, we knew we had to do it right," narrative director Jennifer Brandes Hpler said. "He couldn't just be a final boss. He needs to be a boss that's shaping this game from its opening moments. That's how we decided that, this time, you're not scrambling to shape Sanctuary before Diablo tries to take it over."
Shely added that Diablo "has a lot more to say" in this game. Don't expect Diablo to have some tragic backstory in Diablo 5, though.

"Pretty quickly we kept arriving at the same conclusion: Diablo is Diablo. He is the Lord of Terror," senior producer Tiffany Wat said. "He's not redeemable. He's not misunderstood. That gave us a lot of clarity, so the question now becomes not 'Is he right?' but 'What happens now that he's won?'"
Returning to Westmarch

Shely teased that returning to Westmarch will see players confronting a place that has become an "outpost of Hell." That means very few humans have not bowed to the Lord of Terror or become cultists, with some humans even turning to become Dread Commanders, which harness the power of the Dukes of Hell.
Blizzard also confirmed terrain will change when players return to certain areas. Procedural worlds are also coming back with Diablo 5.

"That idea of not knowing what's around the corner creates a lot of tension," Wat said. "So, in Diablo 5, we're bringing back the procedural world, both in the dungeons and the overworld. So, if you go back to a region that you've been before, all that information knew yesterday - that path that I found, that landmark that I was moving toward, how to fight those Elite monsters - none of that is information is going to help me today."

Diablo fans know Treasure Goblins to be "loot pinatas," but in Diablo 5, one character will change that. Wat teased Zarg, a new character and a Treasure Goblin that players will grow to know. His name's not final and neither are his character details, but he's yet another sign that Blizzard is shaking things up for its next big installment.
First Diablo 5 Classes Confirmed

Shely teased some of the classes coming to Diablo 5. The Demon Hunter and Monk are two returning classes coming to the game. New classes are coming, too, including the heavily armored Plague Knight, which will see players spreading disease and then consuming it for power. That's all he was willing to tease today, but he did say that Diablo 5 will launch with more classes than any other entry than ever before.

"I don't just mean just more classes than any Diablo game at ship," he elaborated. "I mean more classes total. The thing about Diablo classes is they're approachable - you can jump in and immediately have an exciting time playing them - but there's also deep ARPG mastery there and a multitude of builds to explore."
Itemization in Diablo 5

Diablo 5 is still very early in development, so how it handles itemization is still being put together. However, the team was willing to share a sneak peek at concept art for what things look like in this stage of work. Gear-based sets are coming back, with Shely also confirmed that there will be multi-slot items.

"I like to think of itemization kind of like a city," Shely said. "Think about New York City; It's an enormous metropolis, you can immediately go to Time Square and immediately find something cool. That's kind of how I think about our set up. Once you really start to dig in and master it, you learn where's the best deli, where's the best pizza, and you really get into that crunchy opportunity to define your own builds. That's what we want to do in D5."

This is more from Diablo 5 many likely expected to see, but Blizzard doesn't want fans to be overwhelmed by the image they see here. Shely teased that they've got some "really great solutions for any controller players who might be worried about manipulating those items."
Why Announce Diablo 5 Now?

All of the words shared by the Diablo team during the Forging the Next Era BlizzCon 2026 panel are all fine and good, but some fans may be worried that, with years to go until launch, there's no telling what the final product will look like. Zitterman promised that Diablo 5 is a game they hope to build alongside the community, which is why we're learning about it years before its planned launch.

"I think for us it's super important that Diablo 5 feels unmistakably Diablo, in particular for our longtime players," Zitterman said. "That starts with what I talked about at the beginning: Understanding who are Diablo players at their core? What do they want, what do they need, out of a Diablo game?"

He continued: "When you're building a game, you need other people to look at your work and give you that critical feedback. We want to get that feedback now. We want to get that feedback as early as possible. It's why we're announcing today. It's why we're excited to bring the community into the process of making the game along the way toward our launch date."

Zitterman signed off the news portion of the panel by telling players that they won't have to wait long for updates. The plan is for the team to share "regular updates about how development is going" starting in 2027.

"We talked about how D5 will let you define your identity, discover builds, chase memorable loot, right?" Shely added. "More than that, our job is to build the game players want - that you want. Not what we think you should want. We want to build the best Diablo game, and that means listening to you; listening to your feedback, and allowing it to shape the game."

items.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the fo

content.v: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the form of zones, quests, dungeons, raids, and even a new playable race while keeping the old-school MMORPG's world and gameplay intact.

Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , WoW Forever is Blizzard's attempt to give WoW Classic fans the "forever" game they've wanted for years. However, instead of the MMO progressing to the game's subsequent expansions and their new areas, as Classic has in the past, WoW Forever will instead keep the focus on WoW's original two continents, Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

Within that Classic backdrop will be up to 1,000 new quests, Blizzard said, as well as revamped zones, and three entirely new zones that fill out areas present on the map in vanilla WoW but were never accessible to players. There will be nine new dungeons to explore, two raids, and an additional PvP battleground. A new playable race is also part of the package: the Skyborne elves. One of the new playable zones will be their starting area, Blizzard said.

In addition to all-new content, Blizzard will be revamping classes with new talents and skills, as well as allowing for new class and race combinations. An option to toggle HD visuals and old-school graphics will also be included. Blizzard will continue to update WoW Forever with new content, but won't raise the level cap past 60.

Unlike modern WoW, WoW Forever won't be focused on the endgame experience. Blizzard said many of the new dungeons and quests will be for characters under level 60. That aligns with what Blizzard said were its core principles in how it approached development of WoW Forever--that it should be about the journey, not the destination; the world itself is a character; and the game's social aspects should be a focus.
For those who want to continue experiencing the original version of Azeroth, the normal version of WoW Classic will still be playable.
Players won't have to wait long to experience this new version of Azeroth themselves. A playable beta will go live September 17, with the full version of WoW Forever launching November 4.

content.v: The rumored game known to World of Warcraft fans as "Classic Plus" is real, and it has a proper name now—World of Warcraft: Forever is a new branch of the MMO that once again resets the clock to 2004, the year WoW first launched.

But unlike WoW: Classic, the goal of WoW: Forever isn't just to take a trip back to the MMO's origins to relive those heady early years. WoW: Forever will explore new parts of Azeroth, telling stories that weren't told during the MMO's original progression.
PC Gamer was briefed on the announcement before the reveal at the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony. Here are the biggest takeaways:

It's a strategy reminiscent of Old School RuneScape, which treats the 2006 version of the MMO as a jumping-off point rather than a specimen to be preserved. It's worked out well for Jagex: OSRS is bigger now than it was during the original run.

The existence of three different Worlds of Warcraft might risk diluting the playerbase, but if any MMO is big enough to sustain three official forks—and if any studio has the resources to support them—it's probably WoW and Blizzard.

WoW: Forever will be playable at BlizzCon this weekend, and a beta starts this Thursday. The full launch isn't far away either: Forever is set to release on November 4. World of Warcraft: Forever is covered by the pre-existing WoW subscription, but upgrade packs with features like the Skyborne race are available on Battle.net starting at $30.

content.v: As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , setting the stage for the MMORPG's next expansion, The Last Titan.

In a departure for BlizzCon, that glimpse was just about all fans learned about the new expansion, with Blizzard instead looking to put the focus more on the final content patch of the game's current Midnight expansion.

That update, titled Eclipse, will consist of a climactic showdown with the franchise's current main villain, Xal'atath. An in-game cinematic shown during the ceremony revealed Xal'atath's true objective, to merge with Azeroth's worldsoul and become unstoppable.
Blizzard additionally teased a new standalone game mode, and yet another expansion Remix experience, will also be coming to Midnight before the expansion's end.

As for The Last Titan's setting, it takes players back to Northrend, the continent previously seen in 2008's Wrath of the Lich King expansion. Much like how Blizzard revamped Silvermoon City and the Blood Elf lands of Quel'thalas in Midnight to great results, Northrend will be completely rebuilt from the ground up. Blizzard said more details about The Last Titan will be shared next year.

The Last Titan was first announced at BlizzCon 2023, when Blizzard made the unprecedented move of announcing an entire trilogy of expansions all at once. Collectively, Blizzard called the three expansions The Worldsoul Saga, with a goal of bringing together many of WoW's disparate storylines from over the last 20 years into one fitting conclusion.

As the end of the trilogy, The Last Titan has a lot of expectations to live up to that the main storyline of WoW's two previous expansions, The War Within and Midnight, haven't exactly met. Regardless, it will still be exciting to see how Blizzard ties two decades' worth of story involving the Void, the Titans, and Azeroth herself together into one cohesive package.

The Monk's upcoming addition was one of several major pieces of news for Hearthstone revealed. A new expansion called Reign of the Black Empire that is set 10,000 years in the past will focus on the Black Empire and a struggle between the Old Gods and the Titans.

If that excites the lore enjoyer in you, you'll also be happy to hear that the Journal is being transformed into The Journey. This is meant to give a more narrative-driven wrapper to the game, as it'll seek to tie the story together between expansions, modes, and limited-time events. The Journey will grow as you play through Reign of the Black Empire, tying together quests, achievements, and more elements of the game.

Other new features coming to Hearthstone include a new keyword, Assemble, which lets you effectively merge two minions into one, which sounds similar to Magnetize; you can pick specific text from their descriptions to create new combos. content.v: Diablo 5 is coming in Spring 2029, and it will take players to a world where Diablo himself reigns supreme.

Announced via a short teaser during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , Blizzard revealed it's already at work on the next installment of the series. Set 100 years after the defeat of Mephisto in Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred, Diablo 5 will see the Lord of Terror return. However, instead of stopping him from destroying all of Sanctuary, he will actually have already won.

Blizzard teased Diablo 5's story will revolve around what heroes have to become in a post-apocalyptic world that is already destroyed. More details will be shared about the game's lore, classes, and gameplay features, during a Diablo 5 panel as part of this weekend's convention.

Should Diablo 5 actually release in 2029, it will be the shortest gap between Diablo games in the franchise's history. There was a 12-year wait for Diablo 3 after Diablo 2, and another 11 years between Diablo 3 and 4. Diablo 5, in comparison, is slated to come just six years after Diablo 4--still a long time, but much shorter given the franchise's track record.
Blizzard has been on record saying it wants to create new Diablo games faster . In an interview earlier this year, Blizzard said that "over the next 30 years, maybe we get some out faster."

content.v: Diablo 4's next class is Amazon, Blizzard announced during the BlizzCon opening ceremony , but it won't be coming as part of a new expansion. Instead, Blizzard will sell the Amazon as a separate DLC class pack in the first half of next year.

The addition of the Amazon isn't exactly a surprise. First, it's an iconic class from Diablo 2, so it's a bit of a no-brainer there. Alongside the nostalgia factor, Diablo 4's latest expansion, Lord of Hatred, also took players to the literal home of the Amazons, Skovos. They featured heavily in the expansion's story but were not a playable class, with the expansion instead adding the Paladin and Warlock to Diablo 4's class roster.

While the Amazon isn't coming until 2027, Diablo 4's next season, Hell's Legacy, is coming much sooner. The season kicks off next week on September 15 and will celebrate the franchise's 30th anniversary and feature the return of enemies, locations, and items from previous Diablo games. That will include the return of Deckard Cain, who will take players on a journey to confront Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto, meaning the Lord of Terror himself will finally make an appearance in Diablo 4.

content.v: After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , both Roadhog and Sombra will be receiving major reworks, with Sombra pivoting to being a support hero and Roadhog undergoing changes to make him more of a team player.
Shortly after the reveal, Overwatch shared an updated look at both character's Hero kits. Below is a comprehensive overview of their changes:
Sombra
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.45-AM-1.png?w=636

Of the two, Sombra is receiving the most significant redesign, pivoting from a Damage hero to Support. Whereas she used to be most effective at fast-paced, ambush-style combat, she will now be far more useful in team settings. Her Hack ability has been replaced with Hotfix, which allows her to freely hack health packs and enemy deployables as well as heal allies. Cyberspace replaces Virus, and sees Sombra launch a projectile that heals allies and weakens enemies. With the exception of CTRL ALT ESC, all of Sombra's Perks have been adjusted, and she now boasts Support passives.
Roadhog
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.35-AM.png?w=636

By comparison Roadhog's changes are far less dramatic, with the most notable being the removal of Scrap Gun's Alt Fire. In lieu of this skill, Roadhog has been given Trash Compactor--an ability that allows Roadhog to absorb enemy projectiles and turn them into an explosive ball of scrap. This makes him far more effective as an actual Tank, granting him what seems like a fairly effective barrier that will hopefully deter players from abandoning their team in search of smaller firefights.
In addition to these changes, Blizzard has announced Overwatch's 54th character, Doctrine , is coming October 5.

content.v: Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but that game won't be in the traditional real-time-strategy genre the franchise is known for. Instead, the new StarCraft game is described as an open-world shooter.

The news was revealed as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony . However, that's essentially all we know, as the new game-referred to only as StarCraft--won't be released until 2030. As such, there were no further details shared about how it will play or anything else.

After Blizzard's Dan Hay said, "It's about damn time" that we returned to the interstellar war of StarCraft, we did see a cinematic trailer. Dominion forces are shown being pumped up after being trained as elite warriors. They're then sent onto the battlefield against a massive wave of Zerg forces.

When it does arrive, this will mark the first original game in the StarCraft franchise since the StarCraft II trilogy wrapped up with Legacy of the Void in 2015. The original game did receive a remaster, StarCraft Remastered, in 2017, but Blizzard's focus has otherwise shifted to its other franchises over the last decade.

While a StarCraft shooter had been rumored for some time, the reveal is still sure to come as a contentious piece of news for fans starved for a traditional StarCraft game. (The audible reaction from the crowd when "open-world shooter" was said was not necessarily one of elation.)

This isn't the first attempt to spin off the series into something else, as StarCraft Ghost was meant to be a stealth-action entry, but it was ultimately canceled prior to release. A recent report indicated that Nexon is seeking the StarCraft license in order to make a new game--possibly StarCraft III--so there may still be some hope for another StarCraft RTS.

Teases for a StarCraft revival began earlier this month, after the game's official website started to "glitch" and fans discovered hidden text logs. Each one appeared to be a secret transmission hinting at something on the horizon, with rumors circulating that it could be anything from a Helldivers-inspired co-op shooter game to the revival of StarCraft: Ghost.

But the main takeaway is that StarCraft is back, and in a big way. While it wasn't the first successful franchise to emerge from Blizzard, it still remains a key pillar for the company even after years of dormancy. The original StarCraft real-time strategy game and its Brood War expansion were huge hits upon release, and in South Korea, local internet cafes became hubs for competitive PvP that laid the groundwork for the rise of esports.

items.title: Borderlands 4 DLC Character and Free-to-Play Weekend Attract Resurgence on Steam
items.summary: Borderlands 4 is climbing Steam charts as players fall head over heels for its new DLC character – a Vault Hun

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/borderlands-4-loveless-1789234281945.png
Borderlands 4 is climbing Steam charts as players fall head over heels for its new DLC character – a Vault Hunter named Loveless the Hacker.

Gearbox Software's latest Borderlands game struggled in the months following its September 2025 launch. Despite delivering the looter shooter series' biggest launch ever , technical issues across PC and console , as well as Gearbox's handling of the situation , were immediately followed by a steep decline in players, with SteamDB recording numbers that have struggled to break 10,000 concurrent users since January of this year.

Borderlands 4 might have launched to generally favorable reviews (IGN gave it an 8/10 ), but it's struggled to recapture player interest – until now. Thursday, September 10, saw the release of Loveless the Hacker, a DLC character with high-end cybernetics. She's only a small part of a grander Story Pack 2 release, and she seems to be giving the game a second wind.

"Two minds exist inside Loveless, forming a synchronized set of lethal skills that strike as one," a description for Loveless says. "Through a symbiotic melding of the biological and digital, this ex-Anshin hacker-turned-assassin has become a superior lifeform. Equipped with the highest-end cybernetics, Loveless shares her psyche with a digital virus of her own creation, which can digistruct into a physical Wyrm form to act as a deadly extension of her shared, perfection-seeking will."

At the time of this story's publication, Borderlands 4 is enjoying around 26,000 concurrent players on Steam alone. That's the most it's had since November 2025, and far higher than the 17,000-player peak it reached with the launch of Story Pack 1 in March. The base game has also now managed to round out the Top 5 sellers on Steam in the U.S., and it's even come in at nine in the Top 10 global list.

Player counts also appear to be climbing even further, with those in its Steam reviews section specifically calling attention to Loveless as the reason they've decided to return to the planet Kairos. Many refer to voice acting from actress Carin Gilfry as a specific positive, but you can probably guess what a lot of the others had to say.
"Bought the game solely because of Loveless," one review said . "This is how you market."
Bro she’s so bad Loveless? But girl I LOVE YOU pic.twitter.com/ASqXkrZhhX

"Actually a nice character," a popular review said . "Looks good, good design, is insanely OP (can solo bosses without any help). But her alternate heads are a bit -- meh. And she costs $9.99. The VA put some effort into it though. Overall – I think she fits."

"Letting me buy the Vault Hunter without having to by the DLC story pack is the correct call," another fan said , referencing Loveless' $10 asking price compared to the recently released Story Pack 2 expansion. "Glad they learned. Also, step on me Mommy."

There are a number of factors contributing to Borderlands 4's boost in players on Steam, specifically. In addition to Loveless' status as a popular addition, Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort has also helped. There's also the fact that Gearbox is in the middle of a 50% off sale, bringing its price to $34.99 in the midst of a free-to-play weekend that runs until September 14.

It's unclear if the numbers will stick, but it seems to be a winning weekend for Borderlands 4 nonetheless. For more, you can read about what parent company Take-Two had to say about Gearbox's latest as it heads into its second year on the market . You can also read about how Saber took a dig at Gearbox CEO Randy Pitchford .

items.title: 暴雪嘉年华 2026 开幕式：所有最重要的公告和游戏
items.summary: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditi

content.v: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditional opening ceremony full of announcements and reveals for the company's biggest games--and a few surprises!

The biggest of these included the announcement that StarCraft will return in 2030, but this time, Blizzard is switching up genres as the sci-fi game goes from real-time strategy to open-world shooter. Diablo 5 was also announced, and World of Warcraft fans were spoiled with several reveals. In case you missed it, you can catch all the trailers and news below.
Heroes of the Storm
Heroes of the Storm is adding a new hero to its roster for the first time in six years, as Xal'atath is coming to the Nexus. You can try her out starting Monday on the PTR.
For The First Time In 6 Years, Blizzard Is Bringing A New Character To Heroes Of The Storm
A Diablo animated series is in development at Netflix
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Netflix-Diablo.jpg?w=636
The next announcement was about a Diablo animated series in development. Blizzard president Johanna Faries announced that it's being produced by Netflix.
"Diablo, I promise, is just the beginning," Faries teased. "To our Overwatch community, to our Warcraft community, and who knows, perhaps even some of our other universes."
Diablo Animated Series Coming To Netflix, Other Blizzard Franchises Teased
StarCraft returns in 2030

Ubisoft veteran Dan Hay was on stage to announce a brand-new StarCraft, which he described as an open-world shooter. The cinematic trailer showed off some gung-ho Dominion recruits training to be the best in the galaxy, but a few hours later, the remains of these fresh-faced soldiers were being scraped out of their warsuits.
StarCraft Is Officially Back, But It’s Taking A Much Different Form
Overwatch
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Overwatch.jpg?w=636

Overwatch director Aaron Keller was next on stage, dressed in an incredible jacket themed around the game. A new animated trailer was shown off, featuring popular characters like former Talon leader Doomfist, Reaper, Widowmaker, and Sombra as they assaulted a prison pulled from the Watchpoint Gibraltar map. The video ended with a tease of the ninth hero joining Overwatch this year, Doctrine.
Doctrine is a stylish techno-vampire

Miranda Moyer and Ben Bell from the Overwatch team described Doctrine as a Support-class hero who wields a scepter in battle. He mixes vampiric and techno powers together, and he can shroud enemies in darkness to hinder them. Doctrine can also use an "infuse" power to transform his next power. Doctrine's Hero Trial will be available for all Overwatch players later today.
Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
Big Overwatch changes are on the horizon
Sombra and Roadhog are getting some big reworks in Overwatch soon. Sombra is being turned into a Support-class hero, and a whole lot of content is planned for Season 5 of the game.
Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
A familiar face is coming to Diablo 4

Stay a while, and listen to what's next for Diablo! Tiffany Wat and Brent Gibson from the Diablo team announced that everyone's favorite Horadrim scholar, Deckard Cain, will return to Sanctuary soon. You can meet the fan-favorite character in Diablo 4 on September 15, when Season of Hell's Legacy launches.
Hell's Pawn is crossing over to Diablo Immortal
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-Spawn.jpg?w=636
Todd McFarlane's Spawn is coming to Diablo Immortal, which makes my inner '90s kid very happy. Honestly, could you ask for a better crossover character in the free-to-play mobile game?
Diablo 4 lands on Switch 2 in September
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Switch-2.jpg?w=636
And it'll be out on September 15! Switch 2 owners can grab Diablo 4: Age of Hatred Collection when it launches alongside the new Season of Hell's Legacy.
The Amazon is coming to Diablo 4
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Amazon.jpg?w=636

At long last, you can play as an Amazon in Diablo 4. This new take on the fan-favorite character will wield her signature bow, as well as the new javelin-class weapon. She'll be added to the game in the first half of 2027.
Diablo 4’s Next Class Is What You Expect But Isn’t Coming With A Full Expansion
Diablo 5 launches in 2029

With the Age of Hatred having concluded in Diablo 4, it's time for the next chapter in the series. Diablo 5 is currently scheduled to launch in Spring 2029, and things look bleak . In Diablo 5, the ancient Lord of Terror has returned and has conquered Sanctuary.
"What must you become, when the world has already fallen?" Wat teased for the dark direction of Diablo 5.
Diablo 5 Is Coming In 2029, Will Actually Star Diablo
Hearthstone's next expansion launches in October

What's next for Hearthstone? A new expansion and a new gameplay mechanic while you explore a narrative focused on the brawls between Old Gods that shaped the world of Azeroth. The new Assemble mechanic will allow you to fuse two cards together, and the Hearthstone team says that it's well aware that there'll be some "pretty busted" combinations. A pool of 250 cards can make use of this mechanic, and some of the combinations shown off are wild. You can try it out for yourself when Reign of the Black Empire launches on October 20.
Hearthstone's new hero is panda-ring to the Warcraft crowd
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Monk_8ae7c7.jpg?w=636
That's right, the Monk class is finally coming to Hearthstone, marking the first new class in four years.
Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
World of Warcraft: Midnight - Eclipse

World of Warcraft's Holly Longdale and Ion Hazzikostas introduced a new chapter in World of Warcraft's Worldsoul Saga, teasing "all gas and no brakes" in the new major content update. Eclipse will set the stage for a showdown with Xal'atath, and the new cinematic trailer showed her on the verge of a serious power-up.
World of Warcraft: The Last Titan

While Eclipse is the next big narrative chapter in World of Warcraft, The Last Titan is where Blizzard is promising a big shake-up to the MMORPG as it wraps up 20 years of storytelling. More details on it will be shared next year.
WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign

Longdale teased that Blizzard is "putting the war back in Warcraft" with the new campaign, Forsaken Kingdom, for Warcraft 3: Reforged. When can you play it? Today! Players will get to experience the fall of Lodaeron as Human armies took on mighty Orc forces. Other enhancements include a Definitive Edition graphical update, map editor improvements, and you can even select more units to command.
Warcraft Getting Its First New RTS Campaign In Two Decades–And It’s Playable Today
World of Warcraft: Forever

Azeroth is beckoning players back to where it all started, as we got a first look at World of Warcraft: Forever. The rumored Classic Plus mode for World of Warcraft will kick off with a beta on September 17 and launch on November 4. The game will include new dungeons, 10-20 player raids, the Skyborne as a playable race, account-wide perks, and new zones to explore.

items.title: 粉丝在游戏展示会上发起攻击后，5 级 Boss 解决了 AI 的强烈反对
items.summary: Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted 'AI slop' in fo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/professor-layton-and-the-new-world-of-steam-1789228310265.png
Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted "AI slop" in footage of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village , DecaPolice, and more.

Concerns emerged following the studio's Nintendo Direct-style presentation earlier this week. Dubbed Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams, the show came with first looks at upcoming games, and it also happened to feature what fans suspected to be multiple examples of genAI.

Those who tuned into the 50-minute presentation spent more time talking about what they believed was evidence of AI use rather than the games, such as the Professor Layton remake, Yo-Kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, and DecaPolice. The footage causing a stir is mostly limited to background scenes, but it's the fact that fans had to question Level-5 in the first place that's turned the situation into a full-fledged controversy for the Japan-based studio.

Oh no Level-5 is DEFINATELY using Gen AI to "update" Professor Layton. Especially when you compare the original backgrounds to the new. So many weird details and inconsistencies were added. https://t.co/AjVNfgetkk pic.twitter.com/0tRQ9vKn03
⁉️ Dans le nouveau trailer de Yo-kai Watch 2 : Haunted Domain, Nathan a… changé de visage ?! 😭 #YOKAIWATCH Hier (gauche) / Aujourd’hui (droite) pic.twitter.com/Vr3rzwNPA7

"I was SO excited when Level-5 announced their big comeback with Professor Layton, Decapolice, Yo-Kai Watch, and more," one fan on X/Twitter said . "But seeing this much blatant genAI being used across their games… yeah, this ain’t it"
"You were a beautiful studio," another fan said . "Now you are nothing more than a disappointment to us. We don’t want this AI s**t."

Level-5 president and CEO Akihiro Hino, who also hosted the showcase with his own animated avatar, took to X/Twitter to calm the noise. His message was both an apology and an explanation, confirming that Level-5 did, in fact, use generative AI for some aspects of development.
Hino described Level-5's heavy use of AI as "experimentation with the latest technology," adding that the team "sincerely apologizes to anyone who found this off-putting."
I was excited about Decapolice but Level-5 AI use is disgusting to me. I can't support that. https://t.co/EpxgBtCnDo

"However, please be assured that all elements defining the appeal and individuality of our released titles— such as the scenario, character designs, and foundational settings — are created entirely by human hands," Hino said (via Google translate). "We utilize AI primarily to streamline the process of digitizing human-created assets; for instance, accurately converting original artwork into 3D polygon models. You can rest assured that the games we release do not contain content simply generated by AI."

Hino also defended how Level-5 has used AI so far, saying: "the time saved through AI-driven efficiencies has allowed our creators to dedicate more of their efforts to the true essence of creativity." For him and the rest of the team, the belief is that the finished versions of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village will still please fans in the end. Part of the reason it leaned so heavily on genAI this time around was so it could shrink "the development cycle for major titles from the current five years down to two."

"That said, we cannot deny that we made extensive use of AI this time, driven by a desire to deliver a presentation that was visually striking and easy to grasp," he continued. "We will take this experience as a learning opportunity for the future, so please look forward to Level-5’s next presentation."
pic.twitter.com/cict4COGTP

It's an explanation that hasn't gone over well in the Level-5 community. Replies to the post include fans still concerned about generative technology being used during development at all, fearing that affected games will be forever tarnished.

"Generative AI is trained on the stolen works of countless artists by tech companies to profit off their work, with the intent of replacing artists," one popular reply said . "By using it you replaced artists. You're profiting off of the skill of artists whose work has been stolen to power this software."

"I believe the human heart matters more than speed to market; surely it is better to take five years without using AI," another post written in Japanese said (via Google Translate). "If even a single asset is created using AI, the nagging worry — 'Is this image, piece of music, or line of dialogue made by AI or a human?' — would never go away. Isn't preserving that trust the most important thing?"

Hino didn't offer a specific game plan when it comes to how Level-5 will tweak its development plans going forward. For now, Professor Layton and the Curious Village, a remake of the original 2007 game, is slated to come to PC and consoles in 2027 . Another new game in the series, the New World of Steam , is due out this December.

content.v: 近日，有网友在社交平台分享骑行经历，周末骑哈啰“追风者”变速共享单车三个半小时支付了105元。这一事件迅速引发网络热议，不少网友将这款车型称作“单车刺客”，感慨骑行费用甚至超过短途打车，价格争议随之而来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609091210157008.jpg
据悉，这款“追风者”是哈啰在今年4月推出的高端变速共享单车，最先落地天津，之后陆续在石家庄、武汉、上海、长沙等多个城市投放，大多布置在公园、景区、滨江绿道这类休闲区域。
车辆采用公路车架，车座、车架高度高于普通共享单车，搭载自动变速功能，骑行时可以根据速度自动切换档位，骑行体验相较普通单车更加轻快省力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609091210151408.jpg
作为定位高端的车型，它的收费模式和普通共享单车完全区分开，并且没有全国统一的定价标准，不同城市、不同片区，工作日与节假日的计费规则都存在明显差别。
以武汉东湖绿道为例，周末每30分钟收费15元，节假日价格还会进一步上调；上海滨江绿道的同款车型，超出基础时长后的计费标准又有所降低。除此之外，如果用户没有规范还车，还可能产生数十元不等的调度费。
不少消费者之所以踩坑，是因为误将它当成了普通的共享单车，等到结算时才发现花费远超预期。
平台方面表示，该车型属于高端产品，成本更高，所以定价高于普通单车。各地因为运营成本、市场供需不一样，价格存在差异，最终费用以扫码开锁页面展示的信息为准。
